objective: Create an Editor utility that imports JSON content, validates against schemas, and converts to ScriptableObjects.

steps.title: Folder selection
steps.description: User selects a folder containing JSON content in the Editor.

steps.title: Schema resolution
steps.description: Resolve which schema applies to each JSON file (manifest or naming convention).

steps.title: Validate JSON
steps.description: Validate JSON content using a JSON Schema validator and collect errors.

steps.title: Report errors
steps.description: Display errors in an Editor window and write a validation report file.

steps.title: Convert to ScriptableObjects
steps.description: Map validated JSON to ScriptableObject instances and write assets to disk.

steps.title: Options & Idempotency
steps.description: Support dry-run, overwrite, skip duplicates, and consistent naming.

steps.title: Testing & CI
steps.description: Provide unit tests for conversion and add CI step for schema validation in future.

notes: Be mindful of licensing for Newtonsoft.Json.Schema
